summary.text: Mike Crapo has been a U.S. Senator from Idaho since 1999.

paragraphs.text: He served in the Idaho State Senate from 1984 to 1992, including as President Pro Tempore, and in the U.S. House for Idaho's 2nd District from 1993 to 1998.
Born in Bonneville County, Idaho, in 1951, he graduated from Brigham Young University in 1973 and Harvard Law School in 1977.
